notes: Crash fix for v12.82: RecyclerView detach crash (NoClassDefFoundError: ViewGroupKt$iterator$1) when switching to Udhar mode. Root cause was a pruning-tool bug — is_iface() read the wrong class-file bytes, so interface dispatch for Sequence.iterator() was skipped and the class was pruned. Tooling fixed (exact access flags + invokedynamic lambda targets decoded); closure regenerated 216 -> 437 classes (strict superset), 0 unresolved refs; crash class confirmed in the dex. No app code changed. APK +242 KB vs v12.82 (correct closure). RELEASE-SIGNED: installs over v12.77-v12.82 normally; debug installs (v12.76 and older) must uninstall + reinstall first, then restore from JSON backup or re-sync.
